name: stem_beam
description: Short chat (3 steps): set_stem_direction + set_beam_mode at low context (these hallucinated at steps 5-6 of the old long spec).

steps.prompt: Add a quarter note F4 at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1.
Set the stem direction of the chord at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 to up.
Set the beam mode of the chord at measure 1 beat 1 staff 1 to none.
